fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped V-Q-x Governing Equation with Charge ODE
source: Niu, S. et al. (2013) Energy Environ. Sci. 6, 3576 (TENG governing theory); Niu, S. & Wang, Z.L. (2015) Nano Energy 14, 161; Wang, Z.L. (2013) ACS Nano 7(11), 9533
description: Contact-separation mode TENG integrated with external resistive load R via the Niu/Wang governing equation V = -Q/C(x) + sigma*x(t)/eps_0; charge ODE dQ/dt = V/R solved with scipy.solve_ivp.

unit.name: PTFE-Al contact-separation TENG (typical lab device, dielectric-to-conductor)

sigma.note: Triboelectric surface charge density (typical PTFE-Al: 5-50 uC/m^2). Niu 2013.

dielectric_thickness.note: PTFE dielectric thickness 100 um. d0 = d/eps_r is the effective dielectric thickness in vacuum.

R_load_default.note: Optimal load ~10 MOhm for TENG (high internal impedance device)
